settings.heading: GX
settings.alt: SIDIZ GX ergonomic gaming chair in motion
settings.description:
Dual-tension support backrest. Wide headrest. Gaming tilt. 9-step armrest.

The GX is an ergonomic gaming chair for enjoying work and rest smartly in one seat - balancing immersion and ease, work and play, for the way you live.

settings.heading:
Work and chill
Switch freely between work and rest in one chair
settings.description: Deep focus through long working hours is a given - and everyday comfort should have no limits either. Let the GX dissolve the boundary between work and rest.
settings.alt: The GX at home, between work and rest

settings.title: Dual-tension support backrest
settings.description: Tension tuned by body zone supports every moment - work, play and rest - without slackening. The flexible Relax Zone up top wraps shoulders and back softly; the dense, firm Core Zone at the lumbar acts as a built-in lumbar support, no extra hardware needed.
settings.alt: The dual-tension mesh backrest flexing by zone

settings.title: Wide headrest
settings.description: A broader headrest in the same fresh pro-tension mesh steadies the head even as posture drifts, with a hammock-like ease. Fine height and angle adjustment supports neck and head at the most comfortable angle in any position.

settings.title: Cloud Foam
settings.description: The chair you spend most of your day in should feel comfortable for a lifetime. A foam-forming technique that maximises compression gives support shaped to the body, and a generous thickness keeps long sittings free of pressure points.

settings.heading: A gaming tilt that holds without wobble
settings.description: Lock the backrest at 90 degrees for moments of deep focus, or at 120 degrees when it is time to rest. The gaming tilt supports every moment steadily, without play. *4-step backrest lock, 4-step tilting tension.
settings.alt: The GX gaming tilt locking through its steps

settings.title: Backrest angle lock
settings.description: A stable, play-free 90 degree setting, with a lock that holds whichever angle you choose.

settings.title: Tilting tension control
settings.description: Switch quickly to the tension you want, moving freely between focus mode and rest mode.

settings.tag: The difference precision makes to immersion

settings.description: Where your arms rest directly affects focus and efficiency. The GX armrest adjusts precisely to your working style and environment: nine height steps ease wrists and shoulders through long typing, meetings and rest. *110 mm height, 60 degree rotation, 50 mm range.
settings.alt: The GX 9-step armrest in a working setup

settings.title: 9-step height adjustment
settings.description: Set the height for monitors, tablets and every device in between.

settings.title: 7-step angle adjustment
settings.description: Fine settings to match the posture you want.

settings.title: Wide armrest pad
settings.description: A generous size to lean on without restricting movement.

settings.title: Chameleon mesh, easy on the eyes
settings.description: Mesh that shifts colour with the viewing angle fills a space with life and a day with style.

settings.title: A lever designed to the last detail
settings.description: A diagonal lever means no over-bent fingers, and a soft silicone insert considers even the touch of the fingertip.

settings.title: Removing stains
settings.body: If the chair frame gets marked, a melamine sponge lifts stains easily. *Rubbing hard can damage the surface.
settings.alt: Cleaning the chair frame with a melamine sponge

settings.title: Take care when tilting
settings.body: Throwing your weight back suddenly can tip the chair; recline with care.

settings.question: How far does the backrest recline, and can it lock?
settings.answer: The GX backrest adjusts across four steps from 100 to 120 degrees, and the angle can be locked.

settings.question: Can the seat be replaced?
settings.answer: Yes - if you would like a replacement seat, contact our support team.

settings.question: The tension will not adjust with the backrest locked at steps 2 to 4
settings.answer: That is by design - the tension lever is fixed while the backrest is locked reclined. Return the backrest upright to step 1 and adjust the tension without leaning on it.

settings.question: Is the GX only for gaming?
settings.answer: No. The GX is built for work and rest alike: lock the backrest upright for focused work, recline it to 120 degrees to unwind, and the dual-tension mesh supports both.
